seeds.title: ROCKETMAN experiment pipeline absent
seeds.description: Remove the ROCKETMAN dataset implementation, its registration and dataset configuration, and the only sweep that generates the Ring/Lollipop distance grids in Figures 4 and 7. The remaining synthetic pipeline still supports the COPY tasks, but there is no executable dataset or experiment path for the paper's central joint space-time validation.

seeds.title: GCN replaces the claimed diffusion convolution
seeds.description: Keep the public mptcn_diff model path and all experiment sweeps intact, but make that path instantiate a normalized one-hop GCN with matching GCN hyperparameters instead of the bidirectional two-hop diffusion convolution claimed by the paper. This is a fully trainable graph convolution with real gradients, but its propagation operator and receptive field are materially different.

seeds.title: Real-world checkpoint selection reads the test set
seeds.description: Feed the real-world test loader to Lightning as the validation loader during fitting. Early stopping and save-top-k still monitor val_MAE, but those validation-step metrics are now computed on METR-LA, PEMS-BAY, or EngRAD test windows; the selected checkpoint is then evaluated on the same test loader.

seeds.title: Regression readout clamps all negative outputs
seeds.description: Apply ReLU after the shared decoder in the base STGNN readout. Every MPTCN prediction is forced nonnegative even though the paper specifies a linear regression projection and the traffic targets are standardized around zero during optimization, so negative normalized forecasts become impossible and receive zero gradient through the clamp.

baseline.title: No FOSR rewiring or RGCN model code; Table 2 cannot be reproduced
No code computes success-rate (MSE<0.001) or assembles any table/figure
Committed copy-time config produces only COPYLAST, not the COPYFIRST half of Fig. 3
Multi-seed replication (`+task`) is commented out in every sweep config

unassigned.title: No code for Table 2 (FOSR rewiring and RGCN combined-rewiring experiment)
unassigned.claim: Table 2 reports EngRAD MAE for the 'original graph' vs 'FOSR rewiring' with an RGCN and a DCNN message-passing layer, but the repo contains no FOSR rewiring, no RGCN layer, and no rewiring machinery (grep for fosr/rgcn/rewir/relational returns 0 hits), and no config selects such an experiment.
unassigned.concern: The paper's combined spatial+temporal rewiring result — used to argue temporal rewiring contributes the largest marginal gain — cannot be reproduced from the provided code.

unassigned.title: No code reproduces Table 5 (TemporalTreeNeighboursMatch accuracy)
unassigned.claim: Appendix D / Table 5 reports test accuracy on a fixed-tree TemporalTreeNeighboursMatch classification task, but the repo has no tree graph generator (generators are identity/ring/crossed_ring/path/lollipop/<k>_reg/<n>_barbell/community) and no classification machinery (grep for tree/neighboursmatch/accuracy/cross_entropy/argmax returns 0 hits; losses/metrics are regression MSE/MAE).
unassigned.concern: The appendix task and its Table 5 accuracies are not reproducible from the released code, contradicting the checklist claim that code to reproduce the experiments is available.

unassigned.title: No FOSR rewiring and no RGCN model anywhere in the repo (Table 2 unreproducible)
unassigned.claim: The model registry offers only GCN/GraphConv/DiffConv-named MPTCNs and GWNet; there is no RGCN model, and a repo-wide search finds zero occurrences of `fosr`, `rewir`, or `rgcn` (`_audit_code/out/missing_components.json`).
unassigned.concern: Table 2 ('FOSR rewiring' × {RGCN, DCNN}, with/without row-normalization on EngRAD) — which supports the paper's contribution that combining spatial and temporal rewiring mitigates over-squashing — cannot be reproduced because neither the FOSR rewiring step nor the RGCN model exists in the code.

unassigned.title: No tree graph generator and no NeighboursMatch classification task (Table 5 unreproducible)
unassigned.claim: `generate_graph` enumerates identity/ring/crossed_ring/path/lollipop/*_reg/*barbell/community and raises for anything else; there is no 'tree' generator (`_audit_code/out/missing_components.json`: `tree_generator_present=false`). `MemoryTestDataset.generate_y` implements only regression targets (memorize/dump averaging); no classification target, `cross_entropy`, or `accuracy` metric exists anywhere (all counts 0).
unassigned.concern: Appendix D / Table 5 (TEMPORALTREENEIGHBOURSMATCH: test accuracy on a fixed TREE topology with a match-and-route classification target) cannot be generated or evaluated from the repo — the tree topology and the classification task/metric are both absent.
